item.title: Lawmaker says Iran targeted him in phishing attack disguised as TV interview
item.summary: Rep. Randy Fine said an Iranian state actor likely carried out a recent cyberattack on his office in an effort to gain access to his personal Gmail account.

item.title: Trump says he's considering pulling US out of NATO over Iran war stance
item.summary: President Donald Trump said he is considering pulling the U.S. out of NATO after allies declined to support his approach to the Iran conflict.

item.summary: Rising antisemitism and the Passover story inspire an urgent plea for decisive leadership and unified action to protect Jewish communities worldwide.

item.title: Russian military plane crash in Crimea kills 29 people
item.summary: A Russian military transport plane crashed in annexed Crimea, killing 29 people aboard as officials pointed to a possible technical malfunction.

item.title: Palantir CTO warns US has only 'eight days of weapons' in hypothetical battle against China
item.summary: Palantir CTO Shyam Sankar argued AI can give American workers superpowers, helping the U.S. outproduce China and restore its global military edge.

item.title: White House marks Holy Week, Easter with days of prayer centered on religious liberty
item.summary: FIRST ON FOX: The White House is marking Holy Week with days of prayer and worship, with President Trump participating in a number of events to honor the holiday and celebrate the “right to religious liberty."

item.title: Tennessee library director fired for refusing to move LGBTQ books out of kids' section
item.summary: Tennessee's Rutherford County Library Board fired Director Luanne James after she refused to relocate over 100 children's books flagged for controversial themes.

item.title: Weight-loss drugs crush food demand as farmers face dumping mountains of potatoes
item.summary: Potato farmers report a massive surplus as weight-loss medication use cuts food demand. One farmer has 1.3 million pounds worth about $158,000 at risk of spoiling.

item.title: Diamondbacks rookie enters rare company with 2 homers in debut
item.summary: Arizona Diamondbacks third baseman Jose Fernandez became just the seventh person since 1900 to hit two home runs in his major league debut.
